text: Review the proposed Definition 3.2 oracle in arXiv:2610.01995v1 against the pinned debate Lean Oracle. The extracted paper text appears to describe a distribution over finite-domain functions; the debate Oracle maps Boolean histories to Boolean distributions. Resolve sampling time, input/output domains, quantifiers, and whether either notion can be embedded in the other before claiming a common theorem or empirical consequence.
